Findings.Title: Software firewall enabled on every network profile
Findings.Reference: CE v3.3 Firewalls: "protect every device in scope with a correctly configured firewall"; software firewalls on devices used on untrusted networks.

Findings.Title: Unauthenticated inbound connections blocked by default
Findings.Reference: CE v3.3 Firewalls: "block unauthenticated inbound connections by default".

Findings.Title: Operating system is licensed and supported by Microsoft
Findings.Subject: Lifecycle data
Findings.Reference: CE v3.3 Security update management: all software must be licensed and supported, and removed when it becomes unsupported.

Findings.Title: Operating system is licensed and supported by Microsoft
Findings.Reference: CE v3.3 Security update management: all software must be licensed and supported, and removed when it becomes unsupported.

Findings.Title: No Windows security updates outstanding for more than 14 days
Findings.Subject: Overdue
Findings.Reference: CE v3.3 A6.4 (auto-fail): critical/high-risk (CVSS v3 >= 7) or unrated OS updates installed within 14 days of release. CE+ TC2 fails on any such missing fix older than 14 days.

Findings.Title: Applications are up to date (winget)
Findings.Reference: CE v3.3 A6.5 (auto-fail): application updates fixing critical/high-risk or unrated vulnerabilities installed within 14 days of release.

Findings.Title: MFA enforced on every cloud service (attestation)
Findings.Subject: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID
Findings.Reference: CE v3.3 (auto-fail): "authentication to cloud services must always use MFA" where available; cloud services cannot be excluded from scope. CE+ TC4 tests user and admin accounts for an MFA prompt.

Findings.Title: Everyday account is a standard user (separate admin account)
Findings.Reference: CE v3.3 User access control: "use separate accounts to perform administrative activities only". CE+ TC5: an admin action from the user account must prompt for separate admin credentials.

Findings.Title: Anti-malware software installed, enabled and up to date
Findings.Reference: CE v3.3 Malware protection: "make sure that a malware protection mechanism is active on all devices in scope". CE+ TC3.1.3: anti-malware installed, operational and updated.

Findings.Title: Credential theft mitigations (LSA protection, WDigest off, no LM hashes)
Findings.Reference: NCSC Windows device guidance: protect credentials in memory; disable legacy authentication.

Findings.Title: System drive encrypted with BitLocker
Findings.Reference: NCSC Windows device guidance: enable full disk encryption (BitLocker), with a TPM and PIN for pre-boot authentication.

Findings.Title: Virtualisation-based security: Memory Integrity (HVCI) and Credential Guard
Findings.Reference: NCSC Windows device guidance: enable virtualisation-based security features including HVCI and Credential Guard.

Findings.Title: Application control (Smart App Control, App Control for Business or AppLocker)
Findings.Reference: NCSC Windows device guidance: deploy application control and prevent execution from user-writable locations. CE v3.3 allows application allow-listing as an alternative malware mechanism.
